episode_title: #311 David Garrison: Building a Global Real Estate Business | International Property & Agent Referrals

real_qa.q: What neighborhoods in Atlanta are emerging investment opportunities for international buyers?
real_qa.r: South Downtown Atlanta, adjacent to the Mercedes Benz FIFA Stadium, has emerged as a particularly strong market with approximately 50 to 60 untouched buildings requiring renovation. The area has become very walkable with entertainment, shops, restaurants and bars following recent development projects that flourished during the World Cup. Additionally, the area south of the city and south of the airport has a lot of land, is close to the airport, and is starting to see a lot more investment.

real_qa.q: What is the 1% rule metric that Atlanta real estate investors use to evaluate buy-and-hold properties?
real_qa.r: The 1% metric is a basic calculation where investors aim to get 1% of their purchase price back in rent monthly. For example, if you purchase a property for $100,000, you want to generate $1,000 per month in rental income. This metric has been difficult to achieve in many parts of Atlanta for quite a while, but over the past year or so, investors have been able to hit these metrics again in emerging markets.
real_qa.requete: 1% rule real estate investment metric Atlanta

real_qa.q: What Spanish coastal property developments does David Garrison represent for international buyers?
real_qa.r: Through partnerships with an agency representing up to 200 different builders, Garrison offers coastal properties ranging from below 200,000 euros to over 2 million euros. These modern, energy-efficient homes are located from Denia south of Valencia down to the Costa del Sol, Malaga, Marbella, and Estepona. Many properties have the ability to be rented short-term in touristic zoning areas where entire developments are zoned for tourist licenses.
real_qa.requete: Spanish coastal properties investment Costa del Sol Marbella

real_qa.q: Why did Spain eliminate its golden visa property investment residency program?
real_qa.r: Spain eliminated its golden visa program approximately a year and a half ago, largely due to pressure from the European Union to rein in the program, similar to pressure applied to other countries like Greece and Portugal. The program previously allowed buyers spending a certain amount of euros on property to be fast-tracked to residency and citizenship. There is discussion that should the opposition party win in Spain's November 29th elections, they may be more favorable to bringing the program back.
real_qa.requete: Spain golden visa elimination property investment residency

real_qa.q: What key planning considerations should international buyers address before purchasing property in Atlanta or Georgia?
real_qa.r: Garrison emphasizes that tax planning and currency conversion planning are critical first steps for international buyers. Additionally, buyers must clarify how they intend to use the property, whether for short-term rental, midterm rental, or other purposes. They must also determine whether they can secure financing or are limited to a cash purchase, and confirm they are legally able to purchase property as a foreign buyer.
real_qa.requete: international buyer real estate tax planning currency conversion Atlanta

guest.titre: Certified International Property Specialist and Real Estate Professional
guest.bio_context: David Garrison has been a realtor for 22 years, serving clients in Atlanta and Georgia with both residential and commercial real estate expertise. He became a Certified International Property Specialist (CIPS) in 2014 and specializes in helping clients navigate international property markets, particularly in the United States and Spain. He was reappointed to the National Association of Realtors Global Business and Alliances Committee for 2027, contributing to strengthening international relationships across the real estate industry.
